Messages.Author: Shankar Gupta
Messages.Body:
If a vampire forced to hunt exercises the option to hunt from another
Vampire via Restricted Vitae, is successful, and then has a Foul Blood
played on him, does the vampire he hunted off get the blood back?

-Shankar

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Rather, he doesn't lose the blood in the first place.
